verdict.rationale: GitLab is a single platform that includes CI/CD (gitlab-docs-19). Its REST API is documented as letting you manage CI/CD processes across multiple projects (gitlab-docs-13), and audit evidence is collected in every pipeline (gitlab-docs-20). That points to cross-project pipeline data a devops lead could aggregate, but the pack never shows a built-in organization-wide view of pipeline runs. Missing for 10: a documented org- or group-level CI/CD pipeline dashboard, cross-project run status and history views, and independent or hands-on corroboration of centralized pipeline visibility.
